title: Pinchbeck
summary: PINCH'BECK, noun [said to be from the name of the inventor.] An alloy of copper; a mixture of copper and zink, consisting of three or four parts of copper with one of zink.

inlines.v: PINCH'BECK, noun [said to be from the name of the inventor.] An alloy of copper; a mixture of copper and zink, consisting of three or four parts of copper with one of zink.
